items.title: Joanne Brackeen interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 10, 2001
items.q: I don’t know, maybe the time Michelangelo and the time these people that did many, many things at one time

ctx.x: Is there a time in history, going back as far as you’d like, that you would have liked to participate in?

I don’t know, maybe the time Michelangelo and the time these people that did many, many things at one time, and they also lived long, some of them lived long lives and they had a chance to really get into a lot of different fields and things. Maybe. I don’t know. I like it now.
